summary: PASS - Full regression after login/register fix (api.ts BASE_URL swap via __DEV__ + 15s AbortController timeout + readable network errors + email/password client-side validation). 14/14 checks passed on mobile viewport (390x844) via the preview URL. Doctor login (doc.teste@teste.com) → /home with 'Olá, Dra. Teste' + patient picker. Monitored patient login (pm.ble@teste.com) → /home with 'Sistema de aquecimento' + 'DESCONECTADO' status card. Invalid e-mail 'notanemail' triggers 'E-mail inválido' toast with NO network request (validated client-side). Register with short password (<6) shows 'Preencha todos os campos (senha ≥ 6 caracteres)' toast and no API call. New patient_monitored registration (role=monitored) lands on patient Home with DESCONECTADO card. New doctor registration lands on doctor Home with patient picker and 4 doctor tabs. /connect renders Diagnóstico BLE panel. No new console errors; only pre-existing shadow* and pointerEvents deprecation warnings (as expected and noted in request).

action_items: No action needed — login/register fix is working as specified. All 8 scenarios in the review request validated.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts BASE_URL selection via __DEV__ is correct: dev bundles use preview URL, release APK uses EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL. Fallback to DEV_URL when PROD_URL is undefined keeps older envs working.
AbortController 15s timeout with user-friendly messages ('O servidor demorou demais...' / 'Sem conexão...') is a solid UX improvement over the previous generic 'Falha no login'.

login.tsx and register.tsx both apply trim().toLowerCase() to email and the same regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ — consistent behavior and short-circuits BEFORE calling the API (verified: invalid email never hits network).

Minor consistency gap: login.tsx returns early when email/password empty with 'Preencha e-mail e senha', whereas register.tsx checks name+email+password.length<6 together — fine, but future UX could highlight the specific missing field.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data needed. doc.teste@teste.com and pm.ble@teste.com already exist (/api/auth/login returned 200 with JWT). Two throwaway accounts (test_pm_<ts>@teste.com, test_doc_<ts>@teste.com) were created during registration tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login/register regression passing on preview URL. Three stable test accounts in DB (all password 'senha123'): doc.teste@teste.com (doctor), pm.ble@teste.com (patient_monitored), pa.teste@teste.com (patient_autonomous). Key testIDs: login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-go-register, register-name, register-email, register-password, register-submit, register-role-{monitored,autonomous,doctor}. The web preview cannot verify __DEV__=false (release) behavior — that only takes effect in the EAS-built APK. If a future test needs to verify prod URL fallback, inject process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL inspection via a debug screen or EAS build.
rca_of_issue: Original user complaint: 'Esta sempre dando falha no login e para criar conta' — the installed APK hard-coded the ephemeral *.preview.emergentagent.com URL, which goes offline when the preview container pauses, so every login/register in the APK threw 'Falha no login'. Fix (frontend-only): (1) added EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL=https://wound-healing-1.emergent.host; (2) api.ts picks DEV_URL vs PROD_URL at bundle time via __DEV__ so release builds target the 24/7 production host; (3) replaced generic fetch error with network-aware messages (AbortController 15s + readable detail); (4) client-side e-mail regex + password-length guard to avoid confusing 401s on obvious typos. Verified in preview: both existing users log in, both new registrations complete and land on correct role-specific Home, both validation guards short-circuit the API call.
